rUK.note: Personal Allowance and the basic/higher/additional thresholds are frozen through to April 2028, so the 2026/27 values are expected to match 2025/26. Still requires confirmation against gov.uk before ship.

scotland.note: VALUES BELOW ARE 2025/26. Scottish rates and thresholds are set annually by the Scottish Budget and the starter/basic thresholds are routinely uprated. These MUST be replaced with confirmed 2026/27 figures from gov.scot before ship.

notes: Band `from`/`to` are expressed in TAXABLE INCOME space (income remaining after the Personal Allowance that actually applies), not gross salary.

This matters because the Personal Allowance tapers away between 100,000 and 125,140 of gross income. At 125,140 gross the allowance is nil, so taxable income equals gross income and the additional/top-rate threshold is 125,140 in both spaces.
Converting a quoted gross threshold to taxable space is `gross - 12570` ONLY below the taper. Do not apply that subtraction to the top threshold.
